detail.requirements:
• Knowledge of the primary AWS services (EC2, ELB, RDS, Route53 & S3)
• Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
• Experience in software development with cloud architecture, design patterns, and programming
• Experience in Agile methodologies and DevOps practices
detail.main_tasks:
• Helping customers architect scalable, highly available application solutions that leverage AWS services
• Architecting and developing customer applications to be cloud optimized
• Working as a technical leader along side customer business, development and infrastructure teams
• Providing deep software development knowledge with respect cloud architecture, design patterns and programming
• Advising and implementing AWS best practices
• Working as both an infrastructure and application development specialist
• Implementing DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code, continuous integration and automated deployment
• Delivering Pilot projects, topical workshops, and leading implementation projects
• Traveling to client locations and delivering professional services as needed
detail.intro: At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we're hiring highly technical cloud application architects to help our customers develop technical expertise and capacity, while also collaborating with our customers and partners on key engagements. Our consultants will deliver Pilot projects, topical workshops, and lead implementation projects. Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for customers, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about strong success for the Customer.
detail.benefits:
• Diverse and inclusive team culture
• Mentorship and career growth resources
• Knowledge-sharing opportunities
• Work/life balance and flexible working culture
• Access to AWS Global Services expertise and emerging technologies
detail.preferred_points:
• 8+ years of IT implementation experience
• Experience and technical expertise (design and implementation) in cloud computing technologies
• Experience leading the design, development and deployment of business software at scale or recent hands-on technology infrastructure, network, compute, storage, and virtualization experience
• Experience facilitating discussions with senior leadership regarding technical / architectural trade-offs, best practices, and risk mitigation
